run_pretrain_gpt2: run the main function to pretrain a GPT2 model with distributed data parallel training
build_gpt2_model: build a GPT2 model with configurable layers, hidden size, attention heads, and activation checkpointing
setup_optimizer_and_scheduler: setup the Adam optimizer with FP16 support and an annealing learning rate scheduler
evaluate_gpt2_model: evaluate a pretrained GPT2 model on validation data and report loss and perplexity metrics
generate_attention_masks: generate attention masks, loss masks, and position IDs for GPT2 sequence data with EOD token handling
